convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'ColorMomentum_AMA' custom indicator with 4 buffers; depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close position functions); multi-timeframe logic with indicator on separate timeframe from chart

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: sell signal closes long (if BuyPosClose=true), buy signal closes short (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values interpreted as fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values interpreted as deposit fraction share per deal

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads 3 consecutive values from ColorMomentum_AMA buffer index 4 at SignalBar offset. Long entry requires Value[1]<Value[2] (momentum was declining) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (momentum turning up) — a momentum reversal upward. Short entry requires Value[1]>Value[2] (momentum was rising) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (momentum turning down) — a momentum reversal downward. Entry permissions are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans. Exit permissions are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. Signal is recalculated on new bar or when Recount flag is set (on copy failure). If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated every tick without new-bar guard. Trade signal timestamps use SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for position tracking via GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator ColorMomentum_AMA must be reimplemented or its buffer values pre-computed. The AMA (Adaptive Moving Average) smoothing of Momentum requires the full indicator source. Buffer index 4 is the signal/color buffer used for trend direction. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose — these need reimplementation with position management, lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), and signal-time-based deduplication. The MM=-0.1 convention (negative=fixed lot) must be handled. SL/TP are in points (not pips) — verify point vs pip semantics with broker digit count. No digit adjustment logic present in this EA — SL/TP values are passed directly to trade functions.
